content.comment_body: Hello, I want to connect a [company_name] [product_name] to process sensor signals and show the values on a display (not an HMI). Ideally, I’d like to use something similar to this: [url] Is it possible to do this without a [product_name] communication module to convert to RS485, or is it not feasible? Best regards, [user_name]
No. No [product_name] supports RS485 directly. Also, I am not familiar with the bus systems mentioned in the product link; I haven't heard of them before.

Hi, From what I understand, your display needs the right driver to communicate with the [product_name]. The [product_name] mainly works with the Profinet protocol, so a [product_name] communication module won’t address your requirements.

analysis.insight_summary: A user asks if it is possible to connect a non-HMI touch display, using an unusual bus protocol, directly to a [company_name] [product_name] for sensor data display, and prefers not to use additional modules for RS485 conversion. Other members point out that the [product_name] does not natively support RS485, communicates primarily over Profinet, and that using a communication module would not solve the issue.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes to have the [product_name] communicate directly with a third-party non-HMI display over an alternative bus system, without the need for extra communication hardware.
